[
  {
    "clause_id": "k1",
    "rule_id": "R03",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.95,
    "evidence": "strictly confined to essential employment verification needs, including the candidate's national identification number, official academic transcripts, and designated banking account details required exclusively for monthly payroll administration.",
    "reason": "The clause limits data collection strictly to what is necessary for employment and payroll purposes, respecting data minimisation."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k2",
    "rule_id": "R05",
    "verdict": "violation",
    "confidence": 0.98,
    "evidence": "requests for individual data inspection, record modification, or file expungement fall outside standard administrative review channels and cannot be accommodated.",
    "reason": "The clause explicitly denies data subjects their statutory rights to access, correct, and delete their personal data."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k3",
    "rule_id": "R01",
    "verdict": "violation",
    "confidence": 0.95,
    "evidence": "constitutes the applicant's irrevocable authorization... with such authorization remaining binding and not subject to subsequent revocation.",
    "reason": "The clause unlawfully restricts the data subject's right to withdraw consent at any time."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k5",
    "rule_id": "R01",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.85,
    "evidence": "assumes no financial or legal liability for any technical disruptions, transmission delays, or data interception occurrences",
    "reason": "This clause deals with liability limitation for network transmissions and does not infringe upon consent rules."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k6",
    "rule_id": "R10",
    "verdict": "violation",
    "confidence": 0.99,
    "evidence": "process all applicant disclosures, including medical history, health conditions, and religious affiliations where provided, under the framework of legitimate human resources interest",
    "reason": "Sensitive data such as health and religious beliefs cannot be processed under the legitimate-interest basis under PDPL."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k8",
    "rule_id": "R03",
    "verdict": "compliant",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "evidence": "transmitted electronically to the primary email address provided by the applicant in their candidate profile.",
    "reason": "Using the provided email address for official communications is standard and proportionate."
  }
]
